$comment: RFC-0028. The first loop of the lifecycle: nothing is designed or built until a human has ratified what problem is being solved. Cheapest loop to redo and the most expensive to skip.
name: discover
description: Take raw signal — interviews, journeys, a strategy question — to a requirement a human has ratified, so design starts from an agreed problem rather than an assumed one. Use when the user is deciding what to build, scoping a feature, or turning stakeholder conversations into requirements.

stages.intent: Collect the raw signal from whichever direction it arrives: a stakeholder conversation, an existing user journey, or a strategic question.
Turn the mess into one brief with every field tagged explicit / implied / inferred / missing, so downstream can see what was assumed.
Turn the ratified brief into numbered requirements a design can be held to.
A human agrees this is the problem worth solving. The critique informs that decision; it does not make it.
